description: This file implements a database driver class for interfacing with IBM DB2 databases via ODBC in PHP. It defines the class ADODB_ODBC_DB2, which provides methods for database-specific behavior such as retrieving server info, managing transactions, schema meta data, and SQL string generation tailored for DB2 through ODBC.

classes.name: ADODB_ODBC_DB2
classes.description: A class extending ADODB_odbc, tailored for IBM DB2 via ODBC, providing database-specific metadata, SQL generation, and utility functions.

classes.name: ADODBRecordSet_odbc_db2
classes.description: A class extending ADORecordSet_odbc, with additional methods for DB2-specific data types.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that sets the connection mode based on the operating system.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about the DB2 server version and description.

methods.name: IfNull
methods.description: Returns SQL string for null-coalescing for a given field.

methods.name: RowLock
methods.description: Implements row-level locking using FOR UPDATE SQL syntax.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieves list of tables or views with optional filtering by schema or type.

methods.name: MetaIndexes
methods.description: Fetches index metadata for a specified table, optionally filtering for primary indexes.

methods.name: SQLDate
methods.description: Generates a date formatting SQL string according to specified format.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Adds limit and offset to SQL queries using FETCH FIRST syntax.
